files.park/README.txt:
Trail maintenance, autumn inspections.

reports.txt holds one line per inspection report.
policy.txt defines the three bands reports are sorted into.
files.park/policy.txt:
Trail maintenance policy

Reports are banded by the number of obstructions found.
Band A: fewer obstructions than maintenance.band_low.
Band B: from maintenance.band_low up to, but not including, maintenance.band_high.
Band C: maintenance.band_high obstructions or more.
The two values are kept in the park configuration.
